sentences.en: My parents keep arguing about stupid things. It's so annoying!
sentences.zh: 我父母老是为一些无聊的事情争论，真是烦人!

sentences.en: It is no use arguing with such a foolish man.
sentences.zh: 和这么愚蠢的人争论是没有用的。

sentences.en: Beth argued that Sally was only pretending to be innocent.
sentences.zh: 贝丝认为莎莉只是假装无辜。

senses.zh: 坚决主张, 提出理由证明 - 说服, 劝说 - 表明
